description: SL Trafikläget 2 is a dataset listed in Sweden's data portal, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by SL. Övergripande information per trafikslag med aktuell status för hur SL-trafiken fungerar. API ’et har endast en metod som returnerar en översiktlig bild över hur trafiksituationen ser ut just nu, med avseende på störningar som kan påverka resenärerna. Coverage: SL. The publisher named on the listing is SL. Its keywords include kollektivtrafik, public transport, transport. The listing shows 2 download or service links in XML, JSON. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://www.trafiklab.se/api/sl-trafiklaget-2/licens). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-oppnadata.
